children: New York, November 18, 2026-- Moody's Ratings today affirmed MGM Resorts International's B1 Corporate Family Rating, B1-PD Probability of Default Rating, and B1 senior unsecured notes. We also affirmed MGM China Holdings Limited's senior unsecured notes rating at B1. MGM China is a 56% owned publicly traded subsidiary of MGM.

title: Moody's Ratings affirms MGM Resorts International's B1 CFR
